newsitem.title: UK: Libya Dec crude prices unchanged or off 5 cts-trade.
newsitem.headline: Libya Dec crude prices unchanged or off 5 cts-trade.

text.p: Libya has left unchanged or cut by 5 cents a barrel its crude oil prices for December, trade sources said.
The prices for Amna, Brega, Sarir and Zueitina crude oils were all cut by five cents a barrel but Bouri, Es Sider and Sirtica were left unchanged.

The December prices are as follows: Amna at 60 cents a barrel below dated Brent, Brega at 40 cents above, Es Sider at 10 cents above, Sarir at 55 cents under, Sirtica at 15 cents above, Zueitina at 40 cents above.
Bouri in December is priced at 35 cents a barrel below Iran Heavy.
